'''Lexi Fernandin''' was an [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Scout/Legends|explorer]] who ran [[Fernandin Scouting Expedition]], a [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] company during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] he led a team to explore the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]].

==Biography==
Lexi Fernandin was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who founded his [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] company, [[Fernandin Scouting Expedition]], during the expansion era of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="GG2-1" /> By recruiting only the best scouts and explorers,<ref name="GG2-2">[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin'', Second Edition]]</ref> Fernandin developed it into one of the finest independent scouting companies in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]],<ref name="GG2-1" /> with a reputation for excellence. They were often hired to discover new [[Planet/Legends|planets]] with raw materials or settlement potential by corporations.<ref name="GG2-2" /> During the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the Republic, he scouted the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jedd Six]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|145|Jedd Six}}</ref> Fernandin was awarded several lucrative contracts within the borders of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]], which kept his company in work for almost a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] before the Authority developed and deployed their own scouting teams.<ref name="GG2-2" />

Fernandin finally retired from field work to take an active role in the business side of the company, but found that, during its reign, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] put a heavy restriction on new exploration<ref name="GG2-1" /> and no longer wanted to develop new civilian settlement opportunities. Over the course of around five [[Standard year/Legends|years]], Fernandin lost his best employees, who left his service for more lucrative work in the corporate or government sectors, education positions, or even freighter hauling.<ref name="GG2-2" /> When permits for new exploration came through from the Empire for the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]], Fernandin led the expedition himself in an effort to keep his company alive. Officially, the scouting was in preparation for colonization by [[Wetyin's Colony (planet)|Wetyin's Colony]], but the Empire was using the company to ferret out the system's secrets.<ref name="GG2-1" />

==Personality and traits==
By the time of the Galactic Civil War, Fernandin was a stout, middle-aged man with a thick, peppered beard. He had great enthusiasm for exploration and discovery and an optimistic attitude. With his company on the line, however, Fernandin overextended himself as he tried to prove that he still was a capable field scout.<ref name="GG2-1" />

==Skills and abilities==
Fernandin was trained to use a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], and his training as a scout meant he was proficient in survival and stealth techniques. He could [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and repair a [[Starship/Legends|starship]], and was skilled in understanding other languages.<ref name="GG2-1" />

==Equipment==
Fernandin carried an [[identi-beacon]], [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], and [[survival pack]], and armed himself with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]].<ref name="GG2-1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lexi Fernandin was designed for inclusion in the [[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin|first edition]] of ''[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin]]'', a supplement to ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' that was published by [[West End Games]] first in [[1989]] and then reprinted into a [[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin (Second Edition)|second edition]] in [[1995]].
